title: The Dirt Road
content: My dreams are often about traveling, going places. There are a lot of different modes (I spent years dreaming about trains, still dream about them a bit but not as much) - but one of the most persistent locations is the Dirt Road. There's always a huge number of people traveling on it, sometimes it's one of the back streets of a small town, but often it's on the side of a hill or a mountain somewhere. Anyone else?
